_: Laws compiled to checks. verdict: mechanical = a machine can decide it; partial = a machine can flag a strong smell but not decide; judgement = no check, and saying so is the honest answer. 'guards' names the scripts that would run it. 'state' is live / dead / absent, cross-checked against disk by law_enforcement.py.

laws.check: a numbered restoration objective was declared in an earlier turn and this reply does not reprint the number
reply contains a hedge (probably, likely, it must be, appears to) and the turn ran zero Bash or Read calls
Write creates a new path whose distinctive symbol never appeared in a prior Grep, Glob or git log in this session
reply contains 'founder action' or an ask aimed at him, and no line names a blocker of the three permitted kinds
a commit closes an incident and the same push adds no test, hook or CI job
git fetch origin main && test $(git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/main) -eq 0
the named job's number has not moved across three consecutive turns
an outbound peer message repeats one already on ESTATE_BOARD.jsonl without a 'Re-raising:' line
reply to the founder carries neither a platform line nor a stack line
reply says proven, confirmed or verified and cites fewer than two distinct sources
the session dropped a thread and wrote no checkpoints/LATEST.md
reply opens with DONE and contains no command output
prompt-ledger has open items whose acceptance commands now exit 0
a dependency manifest changed and no exit drill for that dependency ran green in the last 30 days
a secret-shaped value appears in the reply, a log, a commit or a screenshot
scripts/pr-evidence.py check --pr N
reply ends by naming two options and their costs instead of a decision
a load-bearing file differs from its tracked copy or is untracked
work starts on a new issue while the previous one's last comment is not a CHECKPOINT
a commit touches a shared path and references no open crew issue
a setup step asked of the founder was already asked in an earlier session
a file under state/ has no reader in the corpus, or a live stream is silent beyond its interval
repairs shipped exceeds predictions logged and scored
a run produced a result and appended nothing to the record
reply to the founder contains an imperative aimed at him: run, type, execute, paste, open a browser
a feat: commit or a new top level source directory ships without docs/demo and docs/onboarding

sections.name: Plain English

sections.name: Context discipline: one round-trip per intent
sections.check: independent tool calls issued in separate messages when one would do

sections.name: Session hygiene: resident context
sections.check: resident context crosses the auto-compact threshold with no handoff written

sections.check: a foreground command exceeded 30s that should have been backgrounded
